name: develop-with-worktrees
description: A local-first Codex workflow with safe isolated integration, task governance, and approved mature-workflow delegation.

interface.shortDescription: One confirmed plan for complex multi-AI work; safe local integration.
interface.longDescription: Route only lifecycle and orchestration-state ownership: mature repositories keep native state while one plain-language confirmation, one coordinating conversation, temporary task anchors, and authoritative durable-document boundaries remain available unless explicitly replaced. Managed or approved delegated work can use local-only DWW orchestration and evidence-led completion. Explicit publishing remains a separate dry-run-first, non-force operation after Finish.
capabilities: Temporary task anchors and durable-document routing
defaultPrompt: Use the repository's required workflow for this Git change.
